summary.short: Mexico's Ley General de Aguas sets out the human right to water for personal and domestic use, allocates federal, state and municipal responsibilities, and reforms the Ley de Aguas Nacionales on concessions, assignments, the water registry, rainwater harvesting, reuse and penalties. In force the day after DOF publication.
summary.long: The decree enacts the Ley General de Aguas and amends, adds to and repeals provisions of the Ley de Aguas Nacionales. The General Law recognizes the human right to water for personal and domestic use and its interdependence with other rights, sets principles and elements of the right (including accessibility, affordability and quality), and allocates powers among the Federation, states and municipalities. It establishes a National Water Strategy with baseline scenarios and goals fixed at ten, twenty, forty and sixty years, regulates rainwater harvesting and community and municipal water systems, and provides for water-operating bodies and a water culture program. The amendments to the Ley de Aguas Nacionales revise rules on concessions and assignments, reallocation of volumes, the National Public Water Registry, discharge permits, irrigation districts and water reuse. They set administrative fines in Unidades de Medida y Actualización, revocation and suspension of titles, and prison terms and fines for offences against national waters. Transitional provisions set 180-day periods for state harmonization and for regulations, and the decree enters into force the day after its publication in the Diario Oficial de la Federación.

notes: The text is the decree as adopted, with the Congress closing dateline of 4 Dec 2025 and the Executive's expedition dated 9 Dec 2025; DOF publication date (11-12-2025) comes from registry metadata, not the text. The Ley General de Aguas (Artículo Primero) is new law; Artículo Segundo reforms, adds and repeals specific articles of the Ley de Aguas Nacionales, recorded as one amends row. The decree uses both la Comisión and la Autoridad del Agua for the federal water authority; the term Autoridad del Agua is not defined in the decree. The Procuraduría is not named in the text. Target instrument IDs and identifiers are empty because no registry IDs were supplied and the schema requires strings. Relations and entities sections have entries; their section_status entries are present only because the schema requires them.

evidence.quote: debe emitir un nuevo permiso en el que se establezcan las características particulares de descarga

obligations.summary: Municipalities, Ciudad de México and, where applicable, states must treat their wastewater before discharge into a receiving body.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 91 BIS, párr. 1)
evidence.quote: deberán tratar sus aguas residuales, antes de descargarlas en un cuerpo receptor

obligations.summary: Persons responsible for accidental, negligent or intentional discharges onto national water bodies must notify the Procuraduría and the Autoridad within 24 hours.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 91 BIS 1, párr. 1)
evidence.quote: las personas responsables deberán dar aviso dentro de las 24 horas siguientes a

obligations.summary: Before permit or concession renewal, applicants that generate pollution must submit physical, chemical and organic analyses of receiving waters just before discharge points.
obligations.conditional_on: renewal or grant of permits, concessions or assignments for pollution generators

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 94 BIS)
evidence.quote: un análisis físico, químico y orgánico de las aguas de las fuentes receptoras en puntos inmediatamente previos a la descarga

obligations.summary: The Autoridad must provide support and technical assistance on request to investors, concessionaires and assignees for hydraulic works.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 99, párr. 1)
evidence.quote: proporcionará a solicitud de las personas inversionistas, concesionarias o asignatarias, los apoyos y la asistencia técnica

obligations.summary: Operation, conservation and maintenance of hydraulic infrastructure are charged to the service users.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 110)

obligations.summary: Use of administrative services and national waters requires the user to pay fees set by the Ley Federal de Derechos.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 112, párr. 1)
evidence.quote: motivará el pago por parte de la persona usuaria de las cuotas que establezca la Ley Federal de Derechos

obligations.summary: Regulations implementing the Ley General de Aguas and the reforms must be issued or amended within 180 natural days of entry into force.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, Transitorios de la Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Primero
evidence.quote: se deben expedir o reformar las disposiciones reglamentarias respectivas

obligations.summary: The Comisión Nacional del Agua has six months after publication to make the regulatory adjustments needed for the reassignment mechanism.
obligations.applies_from: six months after publication of the Decree

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, Transitorios de la Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Segundo
evidence.quote: La Comisión Nacional del Agua contará con un plazo de seis meses siguientes a la referida publicación para hacer las adecuaciones reglamentarias

obligations.summary: The Autoridad del Agua must take actions to guarantee the human right to water, food sovereignty and national development arising from the Decree, within 180 natural days.
obligations.applies_from: 180 natural days from entry into force

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, Transitorios de la Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Segundo (párr. final)
evidence.quote: deberá realizar las acciones tendientes a garantizar el derecho humano al agua, la soberanía alimentaria y el desarrollo nacional

obligations.summary: The Comisión Nacional del Agua must promote the issuance of a Norma Oficial Mexicana for updating water-volume measurement systems.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, Transitorios de la Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Cuarto
evidence.quote: deberá promover la expedición de una Norma Oficial Mexicana para la actualización de los sistemas de medición

obligations.summary: The Comisión Nacional del Agua must present a regularization programme for works in free-pumping zones, with guidelines issued within 180 natural days, avoiding water hoarding practices.
obligations.applies_from: 180 natural days from entry into force

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, Transitorios de la Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Quinto
evidence.quote: presentará un programa de regularización respecto de las obras en zonas de libre alumbramiento

obligations.summary: The Comisión Nacional del Agua must implement simplified regularization programmes for concession and assignment titles.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, Transitorios de la Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Sexto
evidence.quote: implementará programas de regularización de títulos de concesión y asignación

obligations.summary: The Autoridad del Agua must regulate the sources, criteria and procedures for identifying responsible water management and good practices under the Responsabilidad Hídrica concept.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, Transitorios de la Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Séptimo
evidence.quote: deberá reglamentar las fuentes, criterios y procedimientos mediante los cuales se identificará

obligations.summary: The Comisión Nacional del Agua must carry out the analyses, evaluations and needs assessments required for implementing the Decree.

evidence.provision: Art. Segundo, Transitorios de la Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Octavo
evidence.quote: llevará a cabo las acciones que correspondan para realizar los análisis, las evaluaciones y la detección de necesidades respectivas
